name: YNAB
description: YNAB lets agents read the budgets, categories, accounts, and transactions of the signed-in account, so they can answer questions about spending and plans. Each user signs in to their own YNAB account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which categories are overspent this month?
How much did I spend on dining out in each of the last three months?
List transactions from the last two weeks that have no category.

apps.name: YNAB
apps.description: Budget, category, and transaction lookup, over YNAB's MCP server with browser sign-in.
